pr_title: Add option to hide health bar when mod disallows failing
pr_body:
- Implement `IApplicableToHUD` and call on entering
- Move fail-blocked mods into an abstract mod class
- Hide health bar in fail-blocked mods if option was disabled

As the title says, Allow for mods to apply changes to the HUD overlay, currently used for hiding the health bar in mods that blocks fail

Closes #5186
pr_comments:
Health bar doesn't get hidden in no fail, like in stable. Relax does though.
Not only the health bar should be hidden, the accuarcy and the combo does, like on stable.

@yousef157 We don't need to match the stable, it's more preferable for health bar to be hidden if you can't fail, what's the point of it being there if it won't do anything

Also, I don't see why the accuracy and the combo should be hidden
I'm not sure about this one. I think it may be better to leave ti up tot he user to decide whether they want to see the health bar. When I play with NoFail on I still like to see how I'm doing.

> I'm not sure about this one. I think it may be better to leave ti up tot he user to decide whether they want to see the health bar. When I play with NoFail on I still like to see how I'm doing.

Resolved, now the player has a setting for hiding the health bar if no fail on gameplay settings.

I'm not the hugest fan of this approach (mod applying to hud), as I see mods being able to affect *gameplay* only. Maybe it's not such a bad idea to expose as you have, but a better approach might be to have the HUD in control of hiding its health bar (by checking mods of a certain type are active).

> I'm not the hugest fan of this approach (mod applying to hud), as I see mods being able to affect _gameplay_ only. Maybe it's not such a bad idea to expose as you have, but a better approach might be to have the HUD in control of hiding its health bar (by checking mods of a certain type are active).

Will that requires undoing every change I made to the mods?
Leave it for now. I need to have a think about this further, may be okay with the current approach until this comes up a second time and we need to reassess.
I was looking into Cinema Mod and `IApplyToHUD` was helpful at getting the UI hidden.

I've aligned this with our code standards:

- No other option was listed as "hide" - we always use "show" for now for consistency
- `HealthBar` is not referenced in the code or UI. We call it Health Display as it may not always be a bar to the user.
- Moved actual transition logic into `HUDOverlay` as it feels better.

Please check my changes and confirm you're okay with them.

issue_context.title: Hide health bar if you can't fail
issue_context.body: It would be better if the health bar becomes hidden whenever you select a mod that you can't fail with like No Fail and Relax Mod
comments: This should be optional. I should be able to play with health bar visible when No Fail is applied.
shift + tab allows you to show everything again at the moment

review_comments: we can just retrieve the bindable from the config just like `showHud`, but that means we'll most likely revert all mod changes
i'm fine with leaving this for now. we'd have to iterate mods locally in `HUDOverlay`, which seems maybe bad.
